profile.headline: Sr. Embedded Software Engineer at Rivian | VW
profile.summary: Served eight years in the Marine Corps leaving with the rank of Sergeant. During my time in the Marine Corps I learned very valuable leadership skills, problem-solving skills, how to work with teams and how to adapt to situations. I am currently working as an embedded software engineer working on body controls for electric vehicles. I enjoy working on embedded systems because it helps me keep knowledgeable in both software and hardware which keeps me well rounded. In my free time I like to build things and test what I know and push me to learn new things I may not be currently doing in my career.

positions.title: Student Worker
positions.description:
•	Provided career resources and college course information and assistance to students, teachers, parents, and counselors; coordinated daily student resource engagements, scheduled activities, programs, and speakers
•	Prepared career education and instructional materials for use by teachers and students; assisted students in locating post-education careers in their fields of study
•	Organized, coordinated, and publicized career-related events and opportunities for students to learn about higher education, career resources, and potential hiring events

positions.title: Non Commissioned Officer
positions.description:
Senior Personnel Supervisor 
•	Managed all aspects of day-to-day operations supporting 10 personnel while coordinating with leaders and adhering to guidance, policy, procedure, and best practices 
•	Directed employment of weapons systems; maintained 100% accountability and serviceability of all assigned equipment in excess of $500K; coordinated with senior and executive leadership to develop organizational strategic plans
•	Led over 50 security operations including combined inter-agency operations with local nationals and US military personnel; managed the distribution of supplies, equipment, and material in excess of $250K

Equipment Technician/Team Leader
•	Facilitated initial and follow-on training for over 20 personnel; provided specific technical guidance and troubleshooting guidance, supporting extended skills reinforcement and knowledge capability 
•	Managed day-to-day administrative operations for 6 personnel which included proper allocation of equipment and supplies, monitoring of pay, benefits, evaluations, promotions, and disciplinary action
•	Employed executive leadership directed training plans to reinforce technical specialty knowledge and facilitate continue professional development to 6 other department members
